verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents Unified Controls: auditors mapped its offered frameworks to a single core control list. Users can filter that list by framework and view framework controls alongside the unified controls. Published SOC 2-, HIPAA- and HITRUST-to-Unified-Control maps exist, and multi-framework action items mean requirements already addressed by another framework don't need redoing, with differences between frameworks visualized. Missing for 10: ISO 27001 is never explicitly named in the mapping evidence, there is no explicit statement that collected evidence (not just controls/action items) carries across frameworks, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
